name: @sudobility/test-db-guard
description: Refuses to run database tests against anything but a localhost database

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run test && bun run build && bun run verify:dist
scripts.verify:dist: node -e "import(process.cwd()+String.fromCharCode(47)+'dist/index.js').then(m=>{const k=Object.keys(m).sort().join(',');const want='TestDatabaseUrlError,scrubDatabaseUrl,setupTestDatabase,validateLocalTestDbUrl';if(k!==want){console.error('dist exports mismatch:',k);process.exit(1)}console.log('dist loads under node ESM:',k)})"
